titulo: The alarm of six, in seven slides
caption:
Day one of the routine lasted until 6:05. The shoes waited by the door. So did the coffee. I’d call it a draft.
Choose friction.
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Cella tipping off a hill toward a warm cloud bed, the alarm ringing
alt.2: a bedroom at 6:00: Cella under a green blanket, an alarm clock, a steaming cup, sneakers by the door, and a second black Cella with a red crown tilting in from the right edge
alt.3: two questions with two or three answers each as plain lines, with Cella in a room beside a wall clock, a window and a door
alt.4: Cella lying on her side across the alarm clock, an empty rocky hill with a small light behind
alt.5: the same room at 11:40, light across the floor, Cella lying in the same shape
alt.6: a long receipt, with Cella looking at it from the side
alt.7: the room at 6:12 p.m. in orange light: Cella standing by the sneakers, the cup without steam
